part.text:
Implemented the fix in `routergroup.go:183`.

When a static file is missing, the handler now switches to `engine.noRoute` instead of `engine.allNoRoute`, preventing global middleware (including the logger) from running a second time while still invoking custom `NoRoute` handlers.

Validated with targeted static/404 tests and the full suite:

```
ok  github.com/gin-gonic/gin
ok  github.com/gin-gonic/gin/binding
ok  github.com/gin-gonic/gin/render
```
